recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-17155 unless a separate future issue changes the DocumentReference.securityLabel element or search-parameter semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17155 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request asking to rename the DocumentReference search parameter from securitylabel to security-label to follow FHIR search-parameter naming conventions.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit 60707816a225593159bcb01c8526f5a9c8dda742, which explicitly names GF#17155 and changes the old DocumentReference spreadsheet search row from securitylabel to security-label.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/documentreference/bundle-DocumentReference-search-params.xml entry uses id DocumentReference-security-label, URL ending DocumentReference-security-label, and code security-label for DocumentReference.securityLabel. Later Jira/community hits about DocumentReference.securityLabel concern element semantics versus meta.security, not this search-parameter rename, and no conflicting community decision was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because exact current-source searches found no stale DocumentReference-securitylabel id, securitylabel URL, or securitylabel search-parameter code, and the active search parameter is already correct.

related_jiras.note: Later published issue clarifying DocumentReference.securityLabel versus meta.security; it does not affect the security-label search-parameter code.
Later no-change request to remove DocumentReference.securityLabel; it concerns element semantics, not this search-parameter rename.
